reviews.title: Brilliant, unique fitness tool!
reviews.text:
GameFrame has been quite the pleasant surprise!

I somehow stumbled across this app when looking for alternatives to Spren and some other body‑scanning tools, and I'm happy I explored it and gave it a chance. 

Developer Michael has been very helpful and responsive. I think the direction this app is headed will turn it into quite a useful tool and an indispensable one at that. 

I really like how it keeps track of photos and turns those into useful insights and suggestions. I’m still learning how to make use of it given the impressive array of features.

Also one incredible feature I discovered is AI Predict. This takes your current photos and gives you what you could look like based on diet and training parameters that are easy to specify. The end result is a physique photo that, at the very least, can act as an inspiration for pushing ahead. I’d tried this with some of the mainstream AIs and the results were nowhere near as good! I have yet to see any other app do this well. 

There are still some rough edges but no dealbreakers. Deserves five stars and more!

reviews.title: Great app for moms
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this fitness app for a little while now, and I genuinely love how simple and motivating it is. Instead of focusing only on numbers like weight or calories, it lets you track your progress through photos. It’s been such a game changer for me.

As a mom, my body has gone through a lot of changes, and it can be hard to see progress day to day. This app helps me actually see the small changes over time, which is incredibly encouraging during this stage of my life. Some days the scale doesn’t move, but the visual progress reminds me that my efforts are still paying off.

I also appreciate how easy it is to use. It doesn’t feel overwhelming or time-consuming, which is important when you’re juggling a busy schedule with kids. It’s become a really positive, low-pressure way for me to stay consistent and feel good about taking care of myself.

Overall, I’d definitely recommend it to anyone, especially moms or anyone in a season of life where traditional fitness tracking feels discouraging. It’s a refreshing and motivating approach to progress.
